blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reusing the scores that select a Best-of- N N winner can overstate its expected reward. We study evaluation from a fixed matrix of K K independent scores per candidate for a policy that selects using J J fresh scores. A single estimator based only on this matrix is exactly unbiased for expected judge reward under every independent, stable collection of candidate-specific score laws if and only if J < K J<K , for every pool size M ≥ N ≥ 2 M\geq N\geq 2 . At J = K − 1 J=K-1 , the selector deepens as K K grows. For independent Gaussian scores with common variance and fixed M ≥ N ≥ 2 M\geq N\geq 2 , the unbiased minimax risk in this regime is of order σ 2 / K \sigma^{2}/\sqrt{K} , attained by Holdout; allowing bias improves the rate to σ 2 / K \sigma^{2}/K . For two candidates, we derive the minimum-variance unbiased estimator at known variance and the sharp asymptotic unbiased minimax constant 1 / ( π ​ 2 ) 1/(\pi\sqrt{2}) , which Holdout attains without knowing the variance. The cyclic average over subsets and ties can be computed in O ⁡ ( M ​ K ​ log ⁡ M ) O(MK\log M) operations. At fixed selector depth, cyclic evaluation of bounded scores has O ⁡ ( K − 1 ) O(K^{-1}) risk uniformly in pool size. The impossibility result concerns the fixed matrix: one additional fresh winner score permits unbiased evaluation of the all- K K policy.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Best-of- N N (BoN) returns the highest-scoring generated candidate ( Nakano et al., 2021 ; Stiennon et al., 2020 ; Lightman et al., 2023 ) . With a stochastic judge, selection favors unusually high score realizations: the observed maximum can rise with N N even when all candidates have the same mean. Independent evaluation avoids reusing selection noise. Judge reward can still disagree with human preferences ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Coste et al., 2024 ; Eisenstein et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: Best-of-N (BON) 返回得分最高的候选人(Nakano等,2021;Stiennon等,2020;Lightman等,2023). 有了斯多克主义的裁判,选取偏好会异常高分的实现:即使所有候选人都有同样的平分,所观察到的最高分也可以随NN而上升. 独立评价避免再使用选择噪声. 法官奖励仍然可以不同意人类偏好(Gao等,2023;Coste等,2024;Eisenstein等,2023.).

blocks.en: We observe K K scores for each of M M candidates and evaluate a policy that selects from a uniform size- N N subset using J J fresh scores per candidate. Its value is the selected candidate’s expected judge mean. We ask whether this value admits an exactly unbiased estimate from the fixed matrix, and what unbiasedness costs in mean-squared error.
